revision_history.title: Stonewake — new spell proposal
revision_history.summary: A Crest folk mason-mage heaves a short wave through an old stone causeway to stop an armed advance. Stonewake proposes a new fictional spell and name for Harmonic Burst while preserving its gameplay.
revision_history.prompt:
Create a NEW original Breachline fantasy spell painting, 1536 x 1024 landscape. Image 1 is an ANATOMY REFERENCE ONLY for the Crest folk: swept ridged bony head crest integrated with smaller arm ridges, chalk-tan skin and russet cheek marks. Invent a different older Crest woman. Do not copy sheet pose, clothes, plain background or lighting.
Scene: an old imperial limestone causeway over a narrow blue-green ravine, now used by a small quarry town. A mason-mage in practical dark teal work clothes, knee pads and a plain leather belt has dropped to one knee on the left side of the stone road, her bare left palm pressed firmly to a paving stone and her other hand bracing at her own knee. Her intent gaze follows a SHORT LOW WAVE lifting the connected cobbles a few yards ahead. This is learned stone magic defending a crossing, not a species power. The leading edge of that unnatural wave rears about knee-high under the boots of one approaching iron-armoured human raider at middle-right, forcing his weight abruptly backward. His near boot slips, his simple wooden shield tilts, a rust cloak swings. One much smaller companion behind him hesitates. Keep figures anatomically grounded and convincing, not ragdolls flying through air. The road behind the mage and bridge parapets remain solid and visibly connected. The force is implied by heavy stones tipping together, falling grit and an honest bodily recoil. No magic rays, drawn circles, sound rings, neon cracks, glowing runes or abstract diagrams. No bell, courtyard duel or archive.
Composition: low oblique view along the road, mage in left lower third and the curved ridge of upturned stone leading toward the near raider in right middle. The wave, her hand contact and his lost footing form one easily understood action. Important figures clear of edges. The distant quarry town is a few quiet broad roof shapes, not an architectural inventory. Restrained drama and immediate human stakes, no giant apocalypse. Pale warm late-afternoon light enters from upper-left and falls consistently across stone, mage crest and armour; cool ravine shadows, teal cloth, rusty red cloak, warm limestone. Both faces readable without a separate spotlight; magic is not a light source. Traditional oil/acrylic painted fantasy, varied deliberate visible brushwork, matte skin/cloth/stone, selective metal reflections. Precise attention on hand, crest and leading stones; broad lost edges in distance and dust. Beautiful colour without overstated saturation, no uniform microdetail, no photographic bokeh, no photo/3D/toy rendering. No text, border, logo, watermark or signature.
